title: Holiday Debt Trap: 73% Start January $1,500 Broke
hook: You'll spend the next six weeks buying happiness on credit — and statistically, you'll still be paying for it in April.
angle: Holiday overspending isn't about generosity — it's a psychology trap stores have perfected over decades, and the January bill is the hidden cost of Christmas most people never calculate.
audience: Anyone who shops for the holidays and uses credit cards, especially those who feel financial stress in January through April
key_numbers: 73% of Americans take on holiday debt
$1,463 average holiday debt into the new year
26% spend more than they earn in December
